items.title: Adobe Fixes 8 Critical Campaign Classic Flaws Allowing Code Execution and Security Bypass
items.summary: Adobe has released patches to address multiple critical security flaws in Campaign Classic that, if successfully exploited, could result in arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. The list of eight vulnerabilities is as follows - CVE-2026-1043
items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan

items.title: GoAhead TLS Flaws Allow Revoked Client Certificates and Enable Session Decryption
items.summary: The GoAhead embedded web server loaded a certificate revocation list into its default TLS backend but never turned revocation checking on, so a revoked client certificate could still pass login on affected setups. The flaw is in builds that use the OpenSSL backend with mutual-TLS
items.author: Swati Khandelwal

items.title: Apple Backports Fix for Exploited CoreGraphics Flaw to Older iPhones and iPads
items.summary: Apple on Monday backported fixes for a high-severity security flaw that was exploited in real-world cyber attacks to older devices. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-86950 (CVSS score: 8.8), is an out-of-bounds write affecting CoreGraphics that could result in arbitrary code
items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan

items.title: Microsoft Authenticator Flaw Let Permissionless Android Apps Steal Work Account Tokens
items.summary: Microsoft has fixed a flaw in its Authenticator app for Android that let a malicious app with no permissions pose as a trusted Microsoft app, such as Teams, and collect sign-in tokens for a victim's work account. Microsoft tracks the flaw as CVE-2026-80097 and fixed it in Authent
items.author: Swati Khandelwal

items.title: Keystone to Destroy 18,835 Hardware Wallets After Hackers Steal Device Verification Key
items.summary: An attacker who gained access to Keystone's website obtained the key that its hardware wallets use to prove they are genuine, the company said in a statement on October 26. Someone with that key could build counterfeit devices that pass the online check owners use to verify a Key
items.author: Swati Khandelwal
